mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.club_id, m.user_id, m.user_name, m.nick_name, m.student_id, m.role_type, m.position_name, m.join_date, m.contribution, m.status, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, c.club_name, u.avatar from club_member m left join club c on m.club_id = c.club_id left join sys_user u on m.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: select club_id from club_member where user_id = #{userId} and role_type in ('1', '2') and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
where m.club_id = #{clubId} and m.role_type = '1' and m.status = '0' and m.del_flag = '0' order by m.member_id asc limit 1 for update
mapper.insert:
insert into club_member
club_id, user_id, user_name, nick_name, student_id, role_type, position_name, join_date, contribution, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark,
#{clubId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{studentId}, #{roleType}, #{positionName}, #{joinDate}, #{contribution}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark},
mapper.delete: update club_member set del_flag = '2' where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0' and role_type != '1'
mapper.select:
SELECT status, count(*) as count FROM club_member WHERE del_flag = '0'
AND DATE(join_date) >= DATE(#{beginTime})
AND DATE(join_date) <= DATE(#{endTime})
AND club_id in #{cid}
GROUP BY status

SELECT count(CASE WHEN DATE(join_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as totalNew, count(CASE WHEN status='0' AND DATE(join_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as activeNew, count(CASE WHEN status='1' AND DATE(join_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as exitedNew FROM club_member WHERE del_flag = '0'
AND club_id in #{cid}
